pages.play_reply:
#Reply_Play ⊹ By replying this command to a music, voice, video, or media file, play it in the connected group or channel. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش ✧ Play
pages.play_link:
#Link_Play ⊹ With this command you can play media via direct link, just type the desired link with a space in front of the command and send it. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش ✧ Play
pages.play_auto_music:
#Auto_Play_Music ⊹ With this command you can automatically search for a music track on YouTube and the bot will automatically play the first top result. You should write the music phrase you want to play in front of the command. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش خودکار موزیک ✧ Play Auto Music
pages.play_auto_video:
#Auto_Play_Video ⊹ With this command you can automatically search for a video on YouTube and the bot will automatically play the first top result. You should write the video phrase you want to play in front of the command. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش خودکار ویدئو ✧ Play Auto Video
pages.play_youtube:
#Search_Youtube ⊹ With this command you can search for your desired media on YouTube and the bot will list the top 10 results for you, then you can click on the link to download your desired item so the bot can play it for you. 📚 Commands:
✧ سرچ یوتیوب ✧ Search Youtube
pages.play_radio:
#Radio_Play ⊹ With this command you can listen to radio channels in different languages that are included in the bots as a live stream. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش رادیو ✧ Radio Play
pages.play_serial:
#Serial_Play ⊹ With this command you can watch Iranian and foreign serials that are included in the bots. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش سریال ✧ Serial Play
pages.play_tv:
#Tv_Play ⊹ With this command you can watch Iranian TV channels that are included in the bots as a live stream. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش تلویزیون ✧ Tv Play
pages.play_satellite:
#Satellite_Play ⊹ With this command you can watch satellite channels in different languages that are included in the bots as a live stream. 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش ماهواره ✧ Satellite Play
pages.play_controls:
#General_Play_Commands ⊹ With these commands you can manage the playback. ⊹ To stop playback: 📚 Commands:
✧ توقف پخش ✧ Stop Play
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To pause playback: 📚 Commands:
✧ مکث پلیر ✧ Pause Play
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To resume playback: 📚 Commands:
✧ ازسرگیری ✧ Resume Play
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To mute playback: 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش بیصدا ✧ Mute Play
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To unmute playback: 📚 Commands:
✧ پخش باصدا ✧ UnMute Play
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To decrease playback speed: 📚 Commands:
✧ کاهش سرعت ✧ Speed Down
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To increase playback speed: 📚 Commands:
✧ افزایش سرعت ✧ Speed Up
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To decrease media volume: 📚 Commands:
✧ کاهش صدا ✧ Volume-
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To increase media volume: 📚 Commands:
✧ افزایش صدا ✧ Volume+
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ Skip forward a few seconds (enter seconds as a number after the command with a space): 📚 Commands:
✧ جلو ✧ Front
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ Skip backward a few seconds (enter seconds as a number after the command with a space): 📚 Commands: ✧ عقب ✧ Back ┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ Set bot volume in voice call (enter volume from 1 to 200 as a number after the command with a space): 📚 Commands: ✧ تنظیم صدا ✧ Set Volume ┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To start voice call: 📚 Commands: ✧ شروع کال ✧ Start Call ┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To end voice call: 📚 Commands: ✧ پایان کال ✧ End Call ┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To get voice call link (group must be public): 📚 Commands: ✧ لینک کال ✧ Link Call
pages.public_group:
#General_Group ⊹ To get the numeric group ID: 📌 In Persian:
✧ شناسه گروه ✧ Group id
✧ شناسه کانال ✧ Channel id
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To get player status: 📚 Commands:

✧ اعتبار پلیر ✧ Expire Player
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ To determine if ID command has photo or not: 📚 Commands:

pages.public_user:
#General_User ⊹ To get user status: ❪ Reply, Username, Numeric ID, and Self-like ❫ 📚 Commands:
✧ آیدی ✧ Id
pages.promote_deputy:
#Deputy_Player ⊹ With these commands you can add or remove your desired user from the bot's deputies list. ❪ Reply, Username, Numeric ID, and Self-like ❫ 📚 Commands:
✧ ارتقا معاون پلیر ✧ SetDeputy Player
✧ عزل معاون پلیر ✧ RemDeputy Player
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ With these commands you can view or clear the bot's deputies list. 📚 Commands:
✧ لیست معاونان پلیر ✧ ListDeputy Player
✧ پاکسازی لیست معاونان پلیر ✧ ClearListDeputy Player
pages.promote_admin:
#Admin_Player ⊹ With these commands you can add or remove your desired user from the bot's managers list. ❪ Reply, Username, Numeric ID, and Self-like ❫ 📚 Commands:
✧ ارتقا مقام پلیر ✧ Promote Player
✧ عزل مقام پلیر ✧ Demote Player
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ With these commands you can view or clear the bot's managers list. 📚 Commands :
✧ لیست مدیران پلیر ✧ ListAdmin Player
✧ پاکسازی لیست مدیران پلیر ✧ ClearListAdmin Player
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ With this command you can make all group admins bot managers and the group creator bot owner. 📚 Commands:
✧ پیکربندی پلیر ✧ Config Player
pages.promote_vip:
#VIP_Player ⊹ With these commands you can add or remove your desired user from the bot's VIP members list. ❪ Reply, Username, Numeric ID, and Self-like ❫ 📚 Commands:

✧ عزل ویژه پلیر ✧ RemVip Player
┈┅┅━━━━━━━━━⊷⊰ ♬ ⊱⊶━━━━━━━━━┅┅┈ ⊹ With these commands you can view or clear the bot's VIP members list. 📚 Commands:

help.getting_started: 🚀 Getting Started 1. Add bot to group & make full admin. 2. Send AddMusic to install. 3. Send Play [Song] to start playing. 4. PM the bot /start for settings.
help.playback: #Playback 📚 Commands: ✧ Play [Name]: Stream from YouTube ✧ Play [Link]: Stream URL ✧ Tv Play: Watch TV channels
help.playlist: #Playlist 📚 Commands: ✧ Listplaylist: View queue ✧ Addtoplaylist: Add to queue ✧ Cleanplaylist: Clear all
help.radio: #Radio_and_TV 📚 Commands: ✧ Tv Play: TV stations ✧ Radio Play: Radio stations
help.group_commands: #Group_Commands 📚 Commands: ✧ Settings: Group panel ✧ Ping: Bot latency ✧ GetPanel: Resend player UI
help.call_commands: #Voice_Chat 📚 Commands: ✧ StartCall: Turn on VC ✧ EndCall 25: Close VC in 25 mins ✧ GetCallLink: VC invite link ✧ Call message active: allow messages in the voice chat ✧ Reset stats call daily: call-stats reset window (Deputy+) ✧ Repeat active: replay the current track when it ends ✧ Clearauto active: auto-delete the playback-stopped notice ✧ Equalizer: pick an audio preset
help.manager_commands: #Mgmt_and_Install 📚 Commands: ✧ AddMusic: Install bot ✧ RemMusic: Uninstall bot ✧ ChargeMusic 100+: Add credit ✧ Unlimit: Unlimited credit
help.private_commands: #PM_Commands 📚 Commands: ✧ /start: Main menu Help is available only inside groups.
help.group_panel: ⚙️ Group Panel Send /settings in the group to configure locks, permissions, and roles.
help.sudo_panel: 👤 Sudo Panel ▪️ Manage credits and monitor installations.
help.owner_panel: 👑 Owner Panel ▪️ Manage sudos and track finances.
help.dev_panel: 🔧 Developer Panel ▪️ Master control, broadcasts, and system config.
help.forcejoin: 🔗 Force Join Requires users to join a sponsor channel before using the bot.
help.troubleshoot: 🔍 Troubleshooting 1. Ensure bot has full admin rights. 2. Check group credit limits. 3. Wait out any Telegram FloodWaits.
help.about: ℹ️ About Advanced Telegram Music/Video Voice Chat Player with high performance & stability.
